name: Sheba
brief: Kingdom known for wealth, trade, and the Queen of Sheba
short: Sheba, also referred to as the South, was a kingdom known for its wealth, trade, and the visit of its queen to King Solomon (<ref="1Ki. 10:1-13; 2Chr. 9:1-12; Ps. 72:10, 15; Isa. 60:6; Jer. 6:20; Ezek. 27:22-23; 38:13; Luke 11:31">1Ki. 10:1-13; 2Chr. 9:1-12; Ps. 72:10, 15; Isa. 60:6; Jer. 6:20; Ezek. 27:22-23; 38:13; Luke 11:31</ref>).
